gameInstructions: Choose the three words that best remember Deborah’s story.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deborah and Barak sang, remembering willing leaders, courageous people, and the God who went before them.

lines.speaker: deborah
lines.text: Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The song honoured those who answered the call and did not hide the cost borne by the land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the land had peace forty years.

gameSuccess: The song remembers courage, wisdom, and people acting together.
name: Ch.7 · The Song
